selection: Well-observed four-image COSMOGRAIL lens selected from primary public 13-year monitoring coverage before fitting or inspection of withheld magnitudes.
public_release_description: Official COSMOGRAIL page describes RDB and CDS light curves as identical except possible magnitude zero point.

publication_baseline.title: H0LiCOW V. New COSMOGRAIL time delays of HE0435-1223

publication_extension.title: COSMOGRAIL XIX: Time delays in 18 strongly lensed quasars from 15 years of optical monitoring

time_origin_note: Official RDB site calls dates MHJD=HJD-2400000.5; CDS2020 ReadMe labels HJD-2400000. Numerical epochs match across files. Use native numerical epochs for splitting and time differences; do not infer absolute calendar conversion pending resolution of metadata discrepancy.

split_metadata_only.cut_rule: Native numerical epoch <=57447.03918 trains; all larger epochs are withheld. Boundary fixed by endpoint of the13-year public release, independent of later measured magnitudes.

licensing.status: CDS rules explicitly permit scientific use of VizieR data with citation of original authors, publication and publisher; A&A-origin data are free for scientific usage. No blanket CC licence is asserted for this dataset.
licensing.attribution: Bonvin et al. (2017, MNRAS465,4914; Oxford University Press), Millon et al. (2020, A&A640,A105; EDP Sciences), COSMOGRAIL and CDS/VizieR.
licensing.required_action: Retain original third-party data attribution; do not relabel raw observations as repository-owned.
licensing.recommended_acknowledgment: This research has made use of the VizieR catalogue access tool, CDS, Strasbourg, France (DOI:10.26093/cds/vizier).

notes: No published delays or cosmological posteriors are used as fit observations.
Only time-column metadata inspected in the extension; no withheld photometric values examined or fitted.
Proposed historical split trains on native epoch <= endpoint of the original13-year release and withholds all later extension epochs.

The extension has a net18 more pre-cut rows:49 original epochs removed and67 added. It also re-reduces some historical photometry. Fit extended-release pre-cut rows and freeze before withholding extended-release later rows, retaining the original release endpoint as an independently selected chronological boundary. This is retrospective chronological validation within a common photometric reduction, not a prospectively blinded acquisition.
No absolute-Julian-date conversion is used: native numerical day differences avoid the half-day discrepancy in release metadata.
